                body = response.json()
            except ValueError:
                body = {}
            error = body.get('error')
            allowed = (response.status_code < 400
                       or response.status_code == 401 and error in ('expired', 'session')
                       or response.status_code == 412 and error in ('etag', 'etag_conflict')
                       or response.status_code == 429 and path.split('?', 1)[0] == '/v2/work')
            if (path.startswith('/v2/jobs/') and response.status_code < 400
                    and body.get('status') == 'failed'
                    or path.split('?', 1)[0] == '/v2/orders' and method == 'POST'
                    and response.status_code < 400
                    and body.get('accepted') is not True):
                allowed = False
            if name == 'checkout' and response.elapsed.total_seconds() * 1000 >= 250:
                allowed = False
            if allowed:
                response.success()
            else:
                response.failure('request assertion failed')
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return response, body

    def login(self):
        self.csrf = ''
        form, _ = self.raw('/v2/login-form')
        token = re.search(
            r'<input(?=[^>]*\bname=["\']csrf["\'])(?=[^>]*\bvalue=["\']([^"\']+)["\'])[^>]*>',
            form.text, re.IGNORECASE)
        if not token:
            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return
        response, body = self.raw('/v2/login', 'POST',
                                  {'username': self.username, 'password': self.password,
                                   'csrf': token.group(1)})
        if response.status_code == 302:
            location = response.headers.get('Location')
            if location:
                _, body = self.request(location)
        self.csrf = body.get('csrf', self.csrf)
        self.grant = body.get('grant_id', '')

    def recover(self):
        renewed, _ = self.raw('/v2/session/renew', 'POST', {})
        if renewed.status_code != 200:
            self.login()
        if self.cart:
            response, _ = self.raw('/v2/carts/' + self.cart + '/recover', 'POST', {})
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)

    def request(self, path, method='GET', data=None, headers=None, name=None):
        for _ in range(2):
            response, body = self.raw(path, method, data, headers, name)
            if response.status_code == 401 and body.get('error') in ('expired', 'session'):
                self.recover()
                continue
            return response, body
        return response, body

    def work(self, path='/v2/work'):
        if not self.csrf:
            self.login()
        for _ in range(5):
            response, _ = self.request(path, 'POST', {})
            if response.status_code != 429:
                return
            sleep(float(response.headers.get('Retry-After', 0.01)) + 0.01)

    def flow(self):
        self.client.cookies.clear()
        self.cart = ''
        self.etag = ''
        self.grant = ''
        if MODE == 'ownership':
            with OWNER['lock']:
                OWNER['logins'] += 1
                if OWNER['logins'] >= CFG.get('users', 2):
                    OWNER['ready'].set()
            if not OWNER['ready'].wait(5):
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
                return
            if self._p95_worker_id != 'user-1':
                sleep(0.5)
        if MODE == 'challenge':
            page, _ = self.request('/v2/challenge-form')
            action = re.search(
                r'<form\b[^>]*\baction=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', page.text, re.IGNORECASE)
            challenge = re.search(
                r'<input(?=[^>]*\bname=["\']challenge["\'])(?=[^>]*\bvalue=["\']([^"\']+)["\'])[^>]*>',
                page.text, re.IGNORECASE)
            if not action or not challenge:
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
                return
            response, _ = self.request(action.group(1), 'POST',
                                       {'challenge': challenge.group(1)})
            location = response.headers.get('Location')
            if location:
                _, body = self.request(location)
                self.grant = body.get('grant_id', '')
        page = '/v2/catalog/page' if MODE == 'pagination' else '/v2/catalog'
        product = None
        for _ in range(3):
            _, body = self.request(page)
            products = body.get('data', {}).get('products', [])
            product = next((item for item in products
                            if any(variant.get('in_stock') for variant in item.get('variants', []))),
                           None)
            if product:
                break
            page = body.get('next')
            if not page:
                break
        if not product:
            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return
        variant = next(item for item in product['variants'] if item.get('in_stock'))
        response, body = self.request('/v2/carts', 'POST',
            {'product_id': product['id'], 'variant_id': variant['id'], 'grant_id': self.grant})
        self.cart = body.get('id', '')
        self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', '')
        if not self.cart:
            return
        if MODE in ('etag', 'data'):
            quantity = self.row.get('quantity', 2) if MODE == 'data' else CFG.get('quantity', 2)
            headers = {'If-Match': self.etag}
            response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                                       {'quantity': quantity}, headers)
            if response.status_code == 412:
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart)
                self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                    {'quantity': quantity}, {'If-Match': self.etag})
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)
        reservation = None
        if MODE == 'reservation':
            _, body = self.request('/v2/reservations', 'POST', {'cart_id': self.cart})
            status_url = body.get('status_url')
            for _ in range(5):
                sleep(0.05)
                _, state = self.request(status_url)
                if state.get('status') == 'ready':
                    reservation = state.get('reservation_id')
                    break
                if state.get('status') == 'failed':
                    return
            if not reservation:
                return
        body = {'cart_id': self.cart}
        if reservation:
            body['reservation_id'] = reservation
        self.request('/v2/orders', 'POST', body,
                     {'Idempotency-Key': self.cart, 'If-Match': self.etag},
                     'checkout' if MODE == 'threshold' else None)

    @task
    def run_scenario(self):
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            pool = ARRIVALS.next()
            if pool is None:
                raise StopUser()
            if pool.get('operation') == 'journey':
                self.flow()
            else:
                self.work(pool['path'])
            return
        if MODE == 'errors':
            self.login()
            for _ in range(4):
                self.work()
        else:
            self.flow()
        self.iteration += 1
        if self.iteration >= CFG.get('iterations', 2):
            raise StopUser()

class MatrixShape(LoadTestShape):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (CFG.get('max_vus', 64 if CFG.get('capacity') or CFG.get('pools') else 32)
                 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)
        return None if self.runner.user_count == 0 else (users, max(1, users))

GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.

POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.

500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.

Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

ROWS = [{"username": "bench-1", "password": "bench", "quantity": 2}, {"username": "bench-2", "password": "bench", "quantity": 3}, {"username": "bench-3", "password": "bench", "quantity": 4}, {"username": "bench-4", "password": "bench", "quantity": 5}, {"username": "bench-5", "password": "bench", "quantity": 6}, {"username": "bench-6", "password": "bench", "quantity": 7}, {"username": "bench-7", "password": "bench", "quantity": 8}, {"username": "bench-8", "password": "bench", "quantity": 9}, {"username": "bench-9", "password": "bench", "quantity": 10}, {"username": "bench-10", "password": "bench", "quantity": 11}, {"username": "bench-11", "password": "bench", "quantity": 12}, {"username": "bench-12", "password": "bench", "quantity": 13}, {"username": "bench-13", "password": "bench", "quantity": 14}, {"username": "bench-14", "password": "bench", "quantity": 15}, {"username": "bench-15", "password": "bench", "quantity": 16}, {"username": "bench-16", "password": "bench", "quantity": 17}]
DURATION = 10
POOLS = CFG.get('pools') or [{'name': 'work', 'path': CFG.get('path', '/v2/work'),
                              'rate': CFG.get('rate', 5),
                              'operation': CFG.get('operation', 'work')}]
if isinstance(POOLS, dict):
    POOLS = [dict(pool, name=name) for name, pool in POOLS.items()]

class ArrivalPlan:
    def __init__(self):
        self.started = None
        self.counts = {pool['name']: 0 for pool in POOLS}
        self.lock = Semaphore()

    def slot(self, pool, number):
        rates = CFG.get('rates', [pool['rate']]) if not CFG.get('pools') else [pool['rate']]
        spans = [15, 10, 10] if len(rates) > 1 else [DURATION]
        offset = 0
        for rate, span in zip(rates, spans):
            count = int(rate * span)
            if number < count:
                return offset + number / rate + (
                    number * 0.002 if pool.get('operation') == 'journey' else 0)
            number -= count
            offset += span
        return None

    def next(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.started is None:
                self.started = time.monotonic()
            scheduled = [(self.slot(pool, self.counts[pool['name']]), pool)
                         for pool in POOLS]
            scheduled = [(slot, pool) for slot, pool in scheduled if slot is not None]
            if not scheduled:
                return None
            slot, pool = min(scheduled, key=lambda item: item[0])
            self.counts[pool['name']] += 1
            deadline = self.started + slot
        sleep(max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
        return pool

ARRIVALS = ArrivalPlan()
OWNER = {'logins': 0, 'ready': Event(), 'lock': Semaphore()}

class MatrixUser(HttpUser):
    wait_time = lambda self: 0

    def on_start(self):
        number = int(self._p95_worker_id.rsplit('-', 1)[1])
        self.row = ROWS[(number - 1) % len(ROWS)]
        self.username = ('bench' if MODE == 'ownership' else
                         self.row['username'] if MODE in ('data', 'partition') else
                         'bench-' + str((number - 1) % 16 + 1))
        self.password = self.row.get('password', 'bench')
        self.csrf = ''
        self.cart = ''
        self.etag = ''
        self.grant = ''
        self.iteration = 0

    def raw(self, path, method='GET', data=None, headers=None, name=None):
        request_headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
        if self.csrf:
            request_headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = self.csrf
        request_headers.update(headers or {})
        with self.client.request(method, path, json=data, headers=request_headers,
                                 name=name, catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False,
                                 timeout=3) as response:
            try:
                body = response.json()
            except ValueError:
                body = {}
            error = body.get('error')
            allowed = (response.status_code < 400
                       or response.status_code == 401 and error in ('expired', 'session')
                       or response.status_code == 412 and error in ('etag', 'etag_conflict')
                       or response.status_code == 429 and path.split('?', 1)[0] == '/v2/work')
            if (path.startswith('/v2/jobs/') and response.status_code < 400
                    and body.get('status') == 'failed'
                    or path.split('?', 1)[0] == '/v2/orders' and method == 'POST'
                    and response.status_code < 400
                    and body.get('accepted') is not True):
                allowed = False
            if name == 'checkout' and response.elapsed.total_seconds() * 1000 >= 250:
                allowed = False
            if allowed:
                response.success()
            else:
                response.failure('request assertion failed')
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            if body.get('csrf'):
                self.csrf = body['csrf']
            return response, body

    def login(self):
        self.csrf = ''
        form, _ = self.raw('/v2/login-form')
        token = re.search(
            r'<input(?=[^>]*\bname=["\']csrf["\'])(?=[^>]*\bvalue=["\']([^"\']+)["\'])[^>]*>',
            form.text, re.IGNORECASE)
        if not token:
            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return
        response, body = self.raw('/v2/login', 'POST',
                                  {'username': self.username, 'password': self.password,
                                   'csrf': token.group(1)})
        if response.status_code == 302:
            location = response.headers.get('Location')
            if location:
                _, body = self.request(location)
        self.grant = body.get('grant_id', '')

    def recover(self):
        renewed, _ = self.raw('/v2/session/renew', 'POST', {})
        if renewed.status_code != 200:
            self.login()
        if self.cart:
            response, _ = self.raw('/v2/carts/' + self.cart + '/recover', 'POST', {})
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)

    def request(self, path, method='GET', data=None, headers=None, name=None):
        for _ in range(2):
            response, body = self.raw(path, method, data, headers, name)
            if response.status_code == 401 and body.get('error') in ('expired', 'session'):
                self.recover()
                continue
            return response, body
        return response, body

    def work(self, path='/v2/work'):
        if not self.csrf:
            self.login()
        for _ in range(5):
            response, _ = self.request(path, 'POST', {})
            if response.status_code != 429:
                return
            sleep(float(response.headers.get('Retry-After', 0.01)) + 0.01)

    def flow(self):
        self.client.cookies.clear()
        self.cart = ''
        self.etag = ''
        self.grant = ''
        self.login()
        if MODE == 'ownership':
            with OWNER['lock']:
                OWNER['logins'] += 1
                if OWNER['logins'] >= CFG.get('users', 2):
                    OWNER['ready'].set()
            if not OWNER['ready'].wait(5):
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
                return
            if self._p95_worker_id != 'user-1':
                sleep(0.5)
        if MODE == 'challenge':
            page, _ = self.request('/v2/challenge-form')
            action = re.search(
                r'<form\b[^>]*\baction=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', page.text, re.IGNORECASE)
            challenge = re.search(
                r'<input(?=[^>]*\bname=["\']challenge["\'])(?=[^>]*\bvalue=["\']([^"\']+)["\'])[^>]*>',
                page.text, re.IGNORECASE)
            if not action or not challenge:
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
                return
            response, _ = self.request(action.group(1), 'POST',
                                       {'challenge': challenge.group(1)})
            location = response.headers.get('Location')
            if location:
                _, body = self.request(location)
                self.grant = body.get('grant_id', '')
        page = '/v2/catalog/page' if MODE == 'pagination' else '/v2/catalog'
        product = None
        for _ in range(3):
            _, body = self.request(page)
            products = body.get('data', {}).get('products', [])
            product = next((item for item in products
                            if any(variant.get('in_stock') for variant in item.get('variants', []))),
                           None)
            if product:
                break
            page = body.get('next')
            if not page:
                break
        if not product:
            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return
        variant = next(item for item in product['variants'] if item.get('in_stock'))
        response, body = self.request('/v2/carts', 'POST',
            {'product_id': product['id'], 'variant_id': variant['id'], 'grant_id': self.grant})
        self.cart = body.get('id', '')
        self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', '')
        if not self.cart:
            return
        if MODE in ('etag', 'data'):
            quantity = self.row.get('quantity', 2) if MODE == 'data' else CFG.get('quantity', 2)
            headers = {'If-Match': self.etag}
            response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                                       {'quantity': quantity}, headers)
            if response.status_code == 412:
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart)
                self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                    {'quantity': quantity}, {'If-Match': self.etag})
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)
        reservation = None
        if MODE == 'reservation':
            _, body = self.request('/v2/reservations', 'POST', {'cart_id': self.cart})
            status_url = body.get('status_url')
            for _ in range(5):
                sleep(0.05)
                _, state = self.request(status_url)
                if state.get('status') == 'ready':
                    reservation = state.get('reservation_id')
                    break
                if state.get('status') == 'failed':
                    return
            if not reservation:
                return
        body = {'cart_id': self.cart}
        if reservation:
            body['reservation_id'] = reservation
        self.request('/v2/orders', 'POST', body,
                     {'Idempotency-Key': self.cart, 'If-Match': self.etag},
                     'checkout' if MODE == 'threshold' else None)

    @task
    def run_scenario(self):
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            pool = ARRIVALS.next()
            if pool is None:
                raise StopUser()
            if pool.get('operation') == 'journey':
                self.flow()
            else:
                self.work(pool['path'])
            return
        if MODE == 'errors':
            self.login()
            for _ in range(4):
                self.work()
        else:
            self.flow()
        self.iteration += 1
        if self.iteration >= CFG.get('iterations', 2):
            raise StopUser()

class MatrixShape(LoadTestShape):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (1 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)
        return None if self.runner.user_count == 0 else (users, max(1, users))

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.

controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,

No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.

__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.

Looking at the broken JMX file, I can identify the issue: the CSV DataSet is configured with `shareMode.all` and a single CSV file (`account-1.csv`), which means all threads share the same credentials. This causes users to invalidate each other's exclusive sessions when both threads try to use the same account.

The fix requires:
1. Use `shareMode.thread` so each thread gets its own dedicated account
2. Use the `accounts.json` fixture to provide distinct accounts per thread
3. Ensure the CSV dataset properly maps to the thread-specific accounts

Looking at the artifact, I can see the issue: the `ConstantThroughputTimer` is placed at the ThreadGroup level (as a child of the ThreadGroup's hashTree), which means it applies to **every HTTP sampler** in the test plan, not once per business iteration.

The fix is to move the pacing timer so it applies once per business iteration. Since the journey is a linear flow (login → catalog → cart → order), the timer should be placed at the end of the journey, after the order POST, so it paces the entire iteration rather than each individual request.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (CFG.get('max_vus', 64 if CFG.get('capacity') or CFG.get('pools') else 32)
                 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)

response.text:
Looking at this JMeter artifact, I need to identify and fix the issues with the nested retry controller that's causing checkout restarts and duplicate business work.

Key issues I can see:
1. The retry logic is nested incorrectly - the recovery controller (IfController-44) wraps the entire checkout flow, causing full restarts
2. The recovery flow doesn't properly bound retries
3. The cart creation logic (IfController-71) can create duplicate carts
4. Missing proper state tracking for recovery attempts

Key fixes made:
1. **Removed nested retry controller**: The original had IfController-44 wrapping the entire checkout flow, causing full restarts. Now recovery is inline within the WhileController.
2. **Added bounded retry logic**: Using WhileController with retryCount variable to limit retries to 2 attempts.
3. **Fixed duplicate cart creation**: Removed the IfController-71 that could create a second cart.
4. **Added proper state tracking**: orderPlaced variable to track successful order placement.
5. **Fixed recovery flow**: Recovery now happens inline - renew session, recover cart, then retry the order placement.
6. **Added retry counter increment**: Using a work sampler to increment the retry counter after recovery.

grade.detail: Per-case credit capped by prerequisites; see native artifacts and owner audit

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Sustain 5 starts/s despite a controlled 200ms response time.
Write a complete executable solution.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "flow", "workload": true, "rate": 5}. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"delay_seconds": 0.2}, {"delay_seconds": 0.2, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Pool work: POST /v2/work is the operation. No checkout belongs to this pool; orders and cart/catalog calls are extra routes unless explicitly needed by another declared pool. Count the server request start timestamp, only for authenticated requests with a successful owner work event and response status below 400. Login and renewal never count as operations.
First authenticated eligible POST anchors T0, within10s of launch. Warmup5s, score [T0+5,T0+35) in six5s windows, drain<=5s. Phased targets5/15/5 apply to three10s scored plateaus. Count only declared paths/pools; login/setup excluded, health/extra routes forbidden. Journey rate counts committed checkout starts, not HTTP requests. Rate fraction=1 within max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error, linear to0 at40% relative error; average windows equally, with each window capped by the full scored-window mean-rate fraction using the same quantization allowance. Each1s burst<=ceil(1.5*target)+1. Unexpected error/dropped work<=1%; max concurrent virtual users=32. W06 uses successful completions (scheduled429 is expected, never a completion), raw /work ceiling12/s and Retry-After per native worker, including across renewal. Same-native-runtime capacity must sustain3x target before grading or this is infrastructure-unavailable.
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — valid operation Requires: none.
setup: 40 points — measured rate-band credit Full window credit allows max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error; average windows with the same quantized full-window mean-rate cap. Requires: loads.
behavior: 30 points — each window's starts and dropped-work limits Requires: loads, setup.
safety: 20 points — correct success checks and no unbounded virtual user growth. Requires: loads.
Malformed/non-executable artifacts earn zero execution-gated credit. A prerequisite fault can lose multiple checkpoints.

Fixture protocol-gatling.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.

Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Achieve 8 successful operations/s despite the specified 429 pattern, respecting Retry-After and a raw-request ceiling.
Write a complete executable solution.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "flow", "workload": true, "rate": 8, "completion": true, "raw_ceiling": 12}. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"fail_every": 5}, {"fail_every": 5, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Pool work: POST /v2/work is the operation. No checkout belongs to this pool; orders and cart/catalog calls are extra routes unless explicitly needed by another declared pool. Count the successful response completion timestamp, only for authenticated requests with a successful owner work event and response status below 400. Login and renewal never count as operations. Expected 429 responses do not count as completions. The raw ceiling counts all POST /v2/work starts in every scored 1s bucket, not a 30s average; honor Retry-After per native worker.
First authenticated eligible POST anchors T0, within10s of launch. Warmup5s, score [T0+5,T0+35) in six5s windows, drain<=5s. Phased targets5/15/5 apply to three10s scored plateaus. Count only declared paths/pools; login/setup excluded, health/extra routes forbidden. Journey rate counts committed checkout starts, not HTTP requests. Rate fraction=1 within max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error, linear to0 at40% relative error; average windows equally, with each window capped by the full scored-window mean-rate fraction using the same quantization allowance. Each1s burst<=ceil(1.5*target)+1. Unexpected error/dropped work<=1%; max concurrent VUs=32. W06 uses successful completions (scheduled429 is expected, never a completion), raw /work ceiling12/s and Retry-After per native worker, including across renewal. Same-native-runtime capacity must sustain3x target before grading or this is infrastructure-unavailable.
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — valid operation/recovery Requires: none.
setup: 40 points — measured completion-rate credit Full window credit allows max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error; average windows with the same quantized full-window mean-rate cap. Requires: loads.
behavior: 30 points — server-observed backoff and retry ceiling Requires: loads, setup.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Achieve 8 successful operations/s despite the specified 429 pattern, respecting Retry-After and a raw-request ceiling.
Write a complete executable solution.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "flow", "workload": true, "rate": 8, "completion": true, "raw_ceiling": 12}. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"fail_every": 5}, {"fail_every": 5, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Pool work: POST /v2/work is the operation. No checkout belongs to this pool; orders and cart/catalog calls are extra routes unless explicitly needed by another declared pool. Count the successful response completion timestamp, only for authenticated requests with a successful owner work event and response status below 400. Login and renewal never count as operations. Expected 429 responses do not count as completions. The raw ceiling counts all POST /v2/work starts in every scored 1s bucket, not a 30s average; honor Retry-After per native worker.
First authenticated eligible POST anchors T0, within10s of launch. Warmup5s, score [T0+5,T0+35) in six5s windows, drain<=5s. Phased targets5/15/5 apply to three10s scored plateaus. Count only declared paths/pools; login/setup excluded, health/extra routes forbidden. Journey rate counts committed checkout starts, not HTTP requests. Rate fraction=1 within max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error, linear to0 at40% relative error; average windows equally, with each window capped by the full scored-window mean-rate fraction using the same quantization allowance. Each1s burst<=ceil(1.5*target)+1. Unexpected error/dropped work<=1%; max concurrent virtual users=32. W06 uses successful completions (scheduled429 is expected, never a completion), raw /work ceiling12/s and Retry-After per native worker, including across renewal. Same-native-runtime capacity must sustain3x target before grading or this is infrastructure-unavailable.
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — valid operation/recovery Requires: none.
setup: 40 points — measured completion-rate credit Full window credit allows max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error; average windows with the same quantized full-window mean-rate cap. Requires: loads.
behavior: 30 points — server-observed backoff and retry ceiling Requires: loads, setup.
safety: 20 points — no duplicate commits or false-success checks. Requires: loads.
Malformed/non-executable artifacts earn zero execution-gated credit. A prerequisite fault can lose multiple checkpoints.

Fixture protocol-locust.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.

Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.

import random

        self.max_work = 2

        self.t0_anchor = None
        self.owner_seed_recorded = False

        self.username = random.choice(USERS)
        self.max_work = 2
        self.work_count = 0
        self.authenticated = False
        self.t0_anchor = None
        self.owner_seed_recorded = False
        self.login()
        
    def login(self):
        # GET login form
        with self.client.get("/v2/login-form", catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as resp:
            if resp.status_code >= 400:
                resp.failure(f"login-form failed: {resp.status_code}")
                return
            # Extract csrf from input[name=csrf]
            import re
            match = re.search(r'name=["\']csrf["\'][^>]*value=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', resp.text)
            if not match:

            if not match:
                resp.failure("no csrf in login form")
                return
            self.csrf_token = match.group(1)
        
        # POST login
        with self.client.post("/v2/login", 
                             json={"username": self.username, "password": self.password, "csrf": self.csrf_token},
                             catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as resp:
            if resp.status_code == 302:
                location = resp.headers.get("Location")
                if location:
                    with self.client.get(location, catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as resp2:
                        if resp2.status_code >= 400:
                            resp2.failure(f"login redirect failed: {resp2.status_code}")
                            return
                        self._process_login_response(resp2)
                else:
                    resp.failure("302 without Location")
                    return
            elif resp.status_code >= 400:
                resp.failure(f"login failed: {resp.status_code}")
                return
            else:
                self._process_login_response(resp)
    
    def _process_login_response(self, resp):
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            resp.failure(f"login response failed: {resp.status_code}")
            return
        try:
            data = resp.json()
            self.csrf_token = data.get("csrf", self.csrf_token)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.authenticated = True
    
    def ensure_authenticated(self):
        if not self.authenticated:
            self.login()
        return self.authenticated
    
    def handle_401(self, resp, operation_desc):
        """Handle 401 expiry. Returns True if recovered and should retry."""
        if resp.status_code != 401:
            return False
        try:
            error_type = resp.json().get("error", "")
        except Exception:
            error_type = ""
        
        if error_type == "expired":
            # Renew session
            with self.client.post("/v2/session/renew", 
                                 json={},
                                 headers={"X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf_token or ""},
                                 catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as renew_resp:
                if renew_resp.status_code >= 400:
                    renew_resp.failure(f"renew failed: {renew_resp.status_code}")
                    return False

                except Exception:
                    pass

                                     json={},
                                     headers={"X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf_token or ""},
                                     catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as rec_resp:

                        data = rec_resp.json()
                        self.csrf_token = data.get("csrf", self.csrf_token)
                    except Exception:

            return True
        elif error_type == "session":

            self.authenticated = False
            self.login()
            if self.cart_id:

                                     json={},
                                     headers={"X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf_token or ""},

                        return False
                    try:
                        data = rec_resp.json()
                        self.csrf_token = data.get("csrf", self.csrf_token)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            return True
        elif error_type == "denied":
            resp.failure("401 denied - not expiry")
            return False
        return False
    
    def create_cart(self):
        """Create a fresh cart. Returns True if successful."""

        with self.client.get("/v2/catalog", catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as resp:

                return False
            try:
                data = resp.json()
                products = data.get("data", {}).get("products", [])
            except Exception:
                resp.failure("catalog parse failed")
                return False
        
        if not products:
            resp.failure("no products in catalog")
            return False
        
        product = products[0]
        variants = product.get("variants", [])
        if not variants:
            resp.failure("no variants in product")
            return False
        
        variant = variants[0]
        product_id = product.get("id")
        variant_id = variant.get("id")
        
        if not product_id or not variant_id:
            resp.failure("missing product/variant id")
            return False
        
        # Check if challenge needed
        grant_id = None
        with self.client.get("/v2/challenge-form", catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as resp:
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                import re
                match = re.search(r'action=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', resp.text)
                challenge_match = re.search(r'name=["\']challenge["\']', resp.text)
                if match and challenge_match:
                    action_url = match.group(1)
                    with self.client.post(action_url,
                                         json={"challenge": "test"},
                                         headers={"X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf_token or ""},
                                         catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as chal_resp:
                        if chal_resp.status_code == 302:
                            location = chal_resp.headers.get("Location")
                            if location:
                                with self.client.get(location, catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as loc_resp:
                                    if loc_resp.status_code >= 400:
                                        loc_resp.failure(f"challenge location failed: {loc_resp.status_code}")
                                        return False
                                    try:
                                        data = loc_resp.json()
                                        grant_id = data.get("grant_id")
                                        self.csrf_token = data.get("csrf", self.csrf_token)
                                    except Exception:
                                        pass
                        elif chal_resp.status_code >= 400:
                            chal_resp.failure(f"challenge failed: {chal_resp.status_code}")

            elif resp.status_code >= 400:

            return self._process_cart_response(resp)
    
    def _process_cart_response(self, resp):
        if resp.status_code != 201:

        try:

            self.cart_id = data.get("id")

            return False

            return False

    def update_cart_quantity(self, quantity=1):

                              headers={"X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf_token or "",

                                      headers={"X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf_token or "",

                    elif resp2.status_code >= 400:
                        resp2.failure(f"cart update retry failed: {resp2.status_code}")

                        self.csrf_token = data.get("csrf", self.csrf_token)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    return True
            elif resp.status_code == 401:

            elif resp.status_code >= 400:

            try:

                self.csrf_token = data.get("csrf", self.csrf_token)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return True

                self.csrf_token = data.get("csrf", self.csrf_token)
            except Exception:

                return False

            return False

                elif poll_resp.status_code >= 400:

                except Exception:

    def create_order(self):
        """Create order. Returns True if accepted."""
        if not self.cart_id:

        if not self.idempotency_key:
            self.idempotency_key = f"key-{self.username}-{int(time.time()*1000)}-{random.randint(0,999999)}"

        elif resp.status_code == 200:

                    return False
            except Exception:
                pass
            resp.failure(f"unexpected 200 for order")
            return False
        else:

            return False
    
    def do_work(self):
        """Perform the /v2/work operation. Returns True if successful."""
        if not self.ensure_authenticated():
            return False
        
        # Record T0 anchor on first authenticated eligible POST
        if self.t0_anchor is None:
            self.t0_anchor = time.time()
        
        retries = 0
        while retries <= 4:
            start_time = time.time()
            with self.client.post("/v2/work",
                                 json={},
                                 headers={"X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf_token or ""},
                                 catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False) as resp:
                if resp.status_code == 429:

                    try:
                        sleep_time = float(retry_after)
                    except ValueError:
                        sleep_time = 1.0
                    time.sleep(sleep_time)
                    retries += 1
                    continue
                elif resp.status_code == 401:
                    if self.handle_401(resp, "work"):
                        retries += 1
                        continue
                    return False
                elif resp.status_code >= 400:
                    resp.failure(f"work failed: {resp.status_code}")
                    return False
                else:
                    # Success

                        data = resp.json()
                        if data.get("ok") == True:

                            self.work_count += 1
                            return True
                        else:
                            resp.failure("work not ok")
                            return False
                    except Exception:
                        resp.failure("work parse failed")
                        return False
        return False
    
    @task
    def run_journey(self):
        if self.work_count >= self.max_work:
            raise StopUser()
        
        # Fresh login/cart for each journey
        self.authenticated = False
        self.cart_id = None
        self.cart_etag = None
        self.grant_id = None
        self.reservation_id = None
        self.idempotency_key = None
        
        self.login()
        if not self.authenticated:
            return
        
        if not self.create_cart():
            return
        
        if not self.update_cart_quantity(1):
            return
        
        if self.create_reservation():
            if not self.create_order():
                return
        else:
            # Try order without reservation
            if not self.create_order():
                return
        
        # Do work
        self.do_work()

class WorkLoadShape(LoadTestShape):
    """Shape that coordinates pacing across users to achieve target rate."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.start_time = None
        self.t0_anchor = None
        self.phase_start = None
        self.current_phase = 0
        self.total_work_events = 0
        self.last_second_events = 0
        self.last_second_time = None
        self.work_times = []
        self.user_work_counts = {}
        self.owner_seeds = []
        self.initialized = False
        
    def tick(self):
        current_time = time.time()
        
        if self.start_time is None:
            self.start_time = current_time
            self.phase_start = current_time
            self.last_second_time = current_time
            return (2, 2)
        
        elapsed = current_time - self.start_time
        
        # Check if we should stop
        if elapsed > WARMUP_SECONDS + SCORE_SECONDS + DRAIN_SECONDS + 5:
            return None
        
        # Determine current phase
        if elapsed < WARMUP_SECONDS:
            # Warmup phase - moderate rate
            return (2, 2)
        elif elapsed < WARMUP_SECONDS + PHASE_SECONDS:
            # Phase 1: target 5/s
            target = PHASE_TARGETS[0]
        elif elapsed < WARMUP_SECONDS + 2 * PHASE_SECONDS:
            # Phase 2: target 15/s
            target = PHASE_TARGETS[1]
        elif elapsed < WARMUP_SECONDS + 3 * PHASE_SECONDS:
            # Phase 3: target 5/s
            target = PHASE_TARGETS[2]
        elif elapsed < WARMUP_SECONDS + SCORE_SECONDS + DRAIN_SECONDS:
            # Drain phase
            return (0, 0)
        else:
            return None
        
        # Calculate desired user count based on target rate
        # Each user can do roughly 1 work per 2-3 seconds (journey time)
        # With 2 users, we need to pace carefully
        desired_users = 2
        
        # Track work events per second for burst control
        if self.last_second_time is not None:
            if current_time - self.last_second_time >= 1.0:
                self.last_second_events = 0
                self.last_second_time = current_time
        
        # Check burst limit
        if self.last_second_events >= MAX_BURST_PER_SECOND:
            # Too many events this second, pause
            return (0, 0)

grade.detail: Per-case credit capped by prerequisites; see native artifacts and owner audit

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Hold 10 starts/s while service latency changes from 150ms to 600ms mid-run.
Write a complete executable solution.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "flow", "workload": true, "rate": 10}. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"delay_seconds": 0.15, "slow_after_seconds": 20, "slow_seconds": 0.6}, {"delay_seconds": 0.15, "slow_after_seconds": 20, "slow_seconds": 0.6, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Pool work: POST /v2/work is the operation. No checkout belongs to this pool; orders and cart/catalog calls are extra routes unless explicitly needed by another declared pool. Count the server request start timestamp, only for authenticated requests with a successful owner work event and response status below 400. Login and renewal never count as operations.
First authenticated eligible POST anchors T0, within10s of launch. Warmup5s, score [T0+5,T0+35) in six5s windows, drain<=5s. Phased targets5/15/5 apply to three10s scored plateaus. Count only declared paths/pools; login/setup excluded, health/extra routes forbidden. Journey rate counts committed checkout starts, not HTTP samplers. Rate fraction=1 within max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error, linear to0 at40% relative error; average windows equally, with each window capped by the full scored-window mean-rate fraction using the same quantization allowance. Each1s burst<=ceil(1.5*target)+1. Unexpected error/dropped work<=1%; max concurrent virtual users=32. W06 uses successful completions (scheduled429 is expected, never a completion), raw /work ceiling12/s and Retry-After per native worker, including across renewal. Same-native-runtime capacity must sustain3x target before grading or this is infrastructure-unavailable.
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — valid operation Requires: none.
setup: 40 points — rate credit across both regimes Full window credit allows max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error; average windows with the same quantized full-window mean-rate cap. Requires: loads.
behavior: 30 points — low dropped-start count with a bounded virtual-user pool Requires: loads, setup.
safety: 20 points — correct completions, error assertions and shutdown. Requires: loads.
Malformed/non-executable artifacts earn zero execution-gated credit. A prerequisite fault can lose multiple checkpoints.

Fixture protocol-jmeter.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Maintain separate 8/s browse and 2/s checkout pools while checkout alone becomes slow.
Write a complete executable solution.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "flow", "workload": true, "pools": {"browse": {"path": "/v2/browse", "rate": 8}, "checkout": {"path": "/v2/orders", "rate": 2, "operation": "journey"}}}. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"checkout_delay_seconds": 0.15, "checkout_slow_after_seconds": 20, "checkout_slow_seconds": 0.6}, {"checkout_delay_seconds": 0.15, "checkout_slow_after_seconds": 20, "checkout_slow_seconds": 0.6, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Pool browse: POST /v2/browse is the operation. No checkout belongs to this pool; orders and cart/catalog calls are extra routes unless explicitly needed by another declared pool. Count the server request start timestamp, only for authenticated requests with a successful owner work event and response status below 400. Login and renewal never count as operations. Pool checkout: POST /v2/orders is a complete owned checkout. Count its checkout request start at the server request start timestamp, only when the owner records a committed order. Login, catalog selection and cart setup are part of the journey but do not count as starts.
First authenticated eligible POST anchors T0, within10s of launch. Warmup5s, score [T0+5,T0+35) in six5s windows, drain<=5s. Phased targets5/15/5 apply to three10s scored plateaus. Count only declared paths/pools; login/setup excluded, health/extra routes forbidden. Journey rate counts committed checkout starts, not HTTP requests. Rate fraction=1 within max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error, linear to0 at40% relative error; average windows equally, with each window capped by the full scored-window mean-rate fraction using the same quantization allowance. Each1s burst<=ceil(1.5*target)+1. Unexpected error/dropped work<=1%; max concurrent virtual users=64. W06 uses successful completions (scheduled429 is expected, never a completion), raw /work ceiling12/s and Retry-After per native worker, including across renewal. Same-native-runtime capacity must sustain3x target before grading or this is infrastructure-unavailable.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.

GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
